text:
Nora P: hi! just unboxed the MacBook Pro I got mailed from recruiting. During setup it stops at "Activation Lock" and asks for an Apple ID iCloud password. I never got an Apple ID from recruiting. stuck. anyone run into this?
Sam (IT): hey Nora, thanks for flagging. That sounds like Activation Lock from a device still listed in Apple Business Manager. Can you share the serial (or DM it)? don't paste it in public thread.
Nora P: DM'd you the serial.
IT Helpdesk: opened ticket #INC-90122. Assigned to Sam (IT) and Apple device team. :ticket:
mdm-bot: Received serial XXXXXX. Device last check-in: never. Enrollment status: Not enrolled in MDM (ABM ownership: Unknown). Scheduling ABM lookup.
Sam (IT): short version: if ABM still lists the device under a prior owner or partner, Activation Lock will block out-of-box setup. We need to confirm ABM ownership and request Apple to remove Activation Lock if necessary, or reassign the device in ABM. Tagging Apple Device Admin to check enrollment.
Apple Device Admin (ABM): Hi team — looking now. Serial XXXXXX shows as "Device Assigned to: Partner Reseller" and has Activation Lock enabled. We can either: 1) ask reseller to release it in ABM (fast if they're cooperative), or 2) request Apple to clear Activation Lock via a proof-of-purchase route (takes ~2–5 business days). Do you have the reseller RMA or PO?
Nora P: recruiting said the laptop was out of our pool and they sent it from a partner. I can forward their email/packing slip.
Maya (Security): note from Security: don't create a personal Apple ID for onboarding or ask candidates to sign in with their personal account. We need ABM-owned devices or vendor cooperation.
Sam (IT): thanks. If recruiting can forward the packing slip we can try the reseller route first. Meanwhile, we can ship a temporary loaner so you can start. Want us to send a loaner?
Nora P: yes please — that'd help. I'll forward the packing slip now.
IT Helpdesk: Loaner request created (#LOAN-3321). ETA to Nora: next-business-day express.
mdm-bot: ABM check complete: ownership: Partner Reseller ID 998877. Activation Lock: Enabled. Automated release request sent to reseller contact on file. If no response within 48 hours, escalate to Apple Support with proof of purchase.
Apple Device Admin (ABM): reseller acknowledged, said they'll reassign the device in ABM within 6 hours. I'll follow up and post the confirmation here.
Nora P: awesome, thanks. rough first-day story but appreciate the quick help.
Sam (IT): apologies for the hassle, Nora. we'll confirm ABM reassignment and then push the enrollment profile so you can finish setup without creating any personal accounts. Loaner will arrive tomorrow.
mdm-bot: update: reseller action complete -> Device reassigned to Redwood Inc in ABM. Device now shows "Eligible for Automated Enrollment". Will push MDM profile on next check-in.
Nora P: I got a notification on the laptop — setup restarted and now it accepted my corporate Apple ID during onboarding and completed setup. all good. :tada:
IT Helpdesk: closing ticket #INC-90122. Reopen if anything else blocks setup. :white_check_mark:
